capabilities: Open the TickTick web app in a new tab via ribbon icon or command
Dock the TickTick view in the right sidebar
Reuse the existing view instead of opening duplicates
Log in and out of TickTick through its own sign-in page
disambiguation: Not a task-sync plugin; it never reads, writes or syncs TickTick data and does not touch your notes.
extras: Desktop only (uses Electron's <webview> tag, absent on mobile); requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or newer; unofficial and not affiliated with or endorsed by TickTick; no telemetry and no credentials stored by the plugin.
intentEvidence: How it differs from other TickTick plugins: those talk to the TickTick API to sync tasks into your notes.
problem: Using TickTick alongside Obsidian means keeping a separate app or browser tab open, and existing TickTick plugins only sync tasks via the API rather than showing the full app.

relations.evidence: Embeds the TickTick web app inside Obsidian, in a tab or in the right sidebar

summary: Webview wrapper that embeds the TickTick web app in an Obsidian tab or right sidebar without syncing any data.
